name: Stand-Up India Scheme
description: Facilitates bank loans between 10 lakh and 1 crore to at least one Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise.
eligibility_text: Facilitates bank loans between 10 lakh and 1 crore to at least one Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise.

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
description: Credit-linked subsidy scheme generating employment opportunities through establishment of micro-enterprises in rural and urban areas. Higher subsidy rate of up to 35% for Special Category beneficiaries (SC/ST/OBC/Minorities/Women/Differently-abled).
eligibility_text: Credit-linked subsidy scheme generating employment opportunities through establishment of micro-enterprises in rural and urban areas. Higher subsidy rate of up to 35% for Special Category beneficiaries (SC/ST/OBC/Minorities/Women/Differently-abled).

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
description: Provides collateral-free institutional credit up to 10 Lakhs to micro/small business units. Special focus on women entrepreneurs and minority-owned informal enterprises transitioning to the formal sector.
eligibility_text: Provides collateral-free institutional credit up to 10 Lakhs to micro/small business units. Special focus on women entrepreneurs and minority-owned informal enterprises transitioning to the formal sector.

name: Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission (ASIIM)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Promotes innovation and enterprise among SC youth with special preference to Divyangs and women entrepreneurs by supporting innovative technology startups with equity funding up to 30 lakhs over 3 years.
eligibility_text: Promotes innovation and enterprise among SC youth with special preference to Divyangs and women entrepreneurs by supporting innovative technology startups with equity funding up to 30 lakhs over 3 years.
source_name: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

name: Pradhan Mantri Vishwakarma Yojana
description: Provides end-to-end support to artisans and craftspeople including toolkit incentive, credit support, digital payments, and marketing assistance for traditional occupations.
eligibility_text: Provides end-to-end support to artisans and craftspeople including toolkit incentive, credit support, digital payments, and marketing assistance for traditional occupations.

name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for MSEs (CGTMSE)
description: Credit guarantee scheme that enables banks to provide collateral-free loans to micro and small enterprises, making credit more accessible to first-generation entrepreneurs.
eligibility_text: Credit guarantee scheme that enables banks to provide collateral-free loans to micro and small enterprises, making credit more accessible to first-generation entrepreneurs.

name: MSE-Cluster Development Programme (CDP)
description: Supports cluster-based micro and small enterprises with common facilities, infrastructure, and modernization assistance for women, SC/ST, and artisan clusters.
eligibility_text: Supports cluster-based micro and small enterprises with common facilities, infrastructure, and modernization assistance for women, SC/ST, and artisan clusters.

name: National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation (NHFDC)
ministry: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
description: Provides loans and concessional assistance for education, training, and business support to persons with disabilities, including entrepreneurs and self-employed individuals.
eligibility_text: Provides loans and concessional assistance for education, training, and business support to persons with disabilities, including entrepreneurs and self-employed individuals.
source_name: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities

name: Prime Minister's Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
description: Supports micro food processing enterprises with credit linked subsidy, common infrastructure, branding, and marketing support for women and rural entrepreneurs.
eligibility_text: Supports micro food processing enterprises with credit linked subsidy, common infrastructure, branding, and marketing support for women and rural entrepreneurs.

name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme
ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
description: Provides seed funding to startups that are innovative, scalable, and have the potential to create employment, with a strong push for women-led and community-inclusive entrepreneurship.
eligibility_text: Provides seed funding to startups that are innovative, scalable, and have the potential to create employment, with a strong push for women-led and community-inclusive entrepreneurship.
source_name: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade

name: Women Entrepreneurship Platform (WEP)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development / MSME
description: Offers mentoring, market access, and support resources for women-owned enterprises across sectors, especially in rural and semi-urban India.
eligibility_text: Offers mentoring, market access, and support resources for women-owned enterprises across sectors, especially in rural and semi-urban India.
source_name: Ministry of Women and Child Development / MSME

name: PM SVANidhi Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Supports street vendors including women, SC/ST, and minorities through collateral-free working capital loans and digital empowerment.
eligibility_text: Supports street vendors including women, SC/ST, and minorities through collateral-free working capital loans and digital empowerment.
source_name: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
description: Skill development and entrepreneurship training program for youth and marginalized communities, enabling employability and self-employment support.
eligibility_text: Skill development and entrepreneurship training program for youth and marginalized communities, enabling employability and self-employment support.
source_name: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
